name: idea-agents
description: Six exploration agents per project (premise-breaker, field-crosser, idea-sizer, and a lazy trogg for each), one ideas/ folder per run, and a guide in Claude's system prompt for running a round

offer.title: Offer the agents
offer.description: On the first prompt in a project without the six agents, ask whether to install them. Home folders and folders you said never for are skipped. /ideas install works either way.
